meta_rows: Black smoke; land use regression (LUR) estimate for annual  mean air pollution concentration (ug/m3) in 1991 - at age 45 years

Black smoke maps were modelled based on a land use regression (LUR) model. BS & SO2 concentrations were modelled as part of the CHESS project (Welcome Trust funded, grant 075883). For details of the models see references Gulliver et al, 2011 (for BS & SO2) and Gulliver et al, 2013 (for NO2). Calculated for 1991 based on the closest year for the cohort 1989.
